title: On a phone the representatives show after the card is expanded
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: You look at an open work order that has a sales representative on a phone.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the work order card as it first opens.
  2. Tap the card's edit button to expand it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the card is collapsed: Lead Technician, Service Advisor and the Sales Representative field are not shown.
  • Step 2: the card expands and shows Lead Technician, Service Advisor and the Sales Representative field reading {Sales-rep-A}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone)

  • S3-R6: “On a phone the work order card opens collapsed, without Lead Technician, Service Advisor or the Sales Representative fields. They show after the card is expanded with its edit button, as Lead Technician and Service Advisor do today. The expand control itself does not change.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 9: “9. (a) as the feature spec: the card's existing edit button, unchanged.”
